description: Electricity Grid Electrical Load is a dataset listed in KAPSARC Data Portal, an energy economics open data portal, published or maintained by King Abdullah Petroleum Studies and Research Center (KAPSARC). Northeast:Northeast Electric Power Dispatching and Communication Center Fujian:Fujian Electric Power Dispatching and Communication Center NEPDCC:National Electric Power Dispatching and Communication Center North China:North China Electric Power Dispatching and Communication Center East China:East China Electric Power Dispatching and Communication Center Central China:Central China Electric Power Dispatching and Communication Center Southern:China Southern Power Grid Power Dispatching and ... Coverage: as titled: Saudi Arabia, the Gulf states, India or the world (see the dataset page). The portal files it under Electricity. Its keywords are Grid Load. The portal shows 2017-08-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY-NC-ND (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-nd/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy, water and transport system studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kapsarc-open-data-portal.
